notes:
Account snapshot / rep notes:
- Company: mid-market product analytics SaaS, in-app assistant + smart search for enterprise customers.
- Initial approach: start on Hosted API to validate UX then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation.
- POC summary: Hosted POC (Jan) showed functional parity; main gap = token cost at peak; Dedicated pilot started 03/01 to validate p95 latency under sustained concurrency.
- Requirements (verbatim from CTO): "We need predictable monthly spend — no surprise overages. If we commit, we expect bounded burst and a capped overage rate."
- Performance targets: p95 <= 300ms for short responses (<512 tokens), sustain ~400 concurrent chats, tail latency critical.
- Throughput & cost: typical baseline = 1.2M tokens/day; expected growth to 3.5M tokens/day in 12 months. Cost sensitivity = medium-high.
- Model prefs: prefer open/Redwood-verified models (7B/13B quantized variants) for cost control; must support automatic fallback to smaller quantized variant during capacity constraints.
- Routing: want smart routing policy - domestic region priority, fallback to hosted for burst but with agreed cost allocation.
- Dedicated asks: reserved commit for 12 months, quarterly ramp increases (25% Q2, 25% Q3, 50% Q4), burst allowance 1.5-2.0x baseline, overage pricing floor needs negotiation (customer asks for 30% discount vs list for overages and a monthly cap).
- Legal/commercial: procurement legal flagged the need for an overage hard cap and explicit SLA credits for p95 latency misses.
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, KMS integration for model inputs, audit logging retention 90 days, data residency (NA) required for enterprise customers.
- POC success criteria: p95 latency <300ms on Dedicated pilot + sustained cost per 1k tokens under agreed threshold.
- Quotes/lines: SE noted "good packing on KV cache reduced token churn"; CTO: "we'll move if we get a clear ramp and overage guardrails".
- Internal: AE to push commercial term sheet with 2 commit tiers (Medium/High) + optional burst pack; propose pilot discount and cap on hourly overage for first 3 months.
- Risks: if overage negotiations stall, customer will evaluate competitor managed offerings with per-instance caps.
- Sent artifacts: pricing_term_sheet_v1 (drive link), dedicated_capacity_design.pdf (drive link stub), security_faq (drive stub).
- Next calls: legal + procurement 60-min review (target week of 2026-03-22), SOC2 attestation scheduling.
